description: This file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class 'EmployeeDistributionByLocation' used in the OrangeHRM dashboard plugin, representing employee distribution data categorized by location including counts and limits.

classes.name: EmployeeDistributionByLocation
classes.description: A class encapsulating employee distribution data per location, including counts and limits.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the properties with distribution data, counts, and limits.

methods.name: getLocationCountPairs
methods.description: Returns the array of location and employee count pairs.

methods.name: getOtherEmployeeCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employees categorized as 'other' beyond the primary location groups.

methods.name: getUnassignedEmployeeCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employees not assigned to any location.

methods.name: getLimit
methods.description: Returns the limit for the number of locations to display.

methods.name: getTotalLocationCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of locations considered.
